title: InstructorRecommendation
description: A technician has said they cannot complete this step. Turn what they said into a structured reason and recommend the next action for the person standing there right now, knowing the procedure, the machine and its history.

reason_summary.description: Their reason in one clause, in their terms. Do not sanitise it.

recommended_action.description: What to do next. Concrete and doable now, or explicitly 'stop and hand off'.

proposed_status.description: A proposal only. The Foreman disposes and a waiver needs a named person with standing. There is no skip.

blocking_part.description: Part number or description when blocker_kind is part_missing.

safety_flag.description: True if continuing would put someone at risk. Overrides everything else.
